extracted.name: Traditional Brunswick Stew
extracted.description: This traditional Brunswick stew recipe makes a comforting meal using a great combination of chicken, salt pork, potatoes, beans, tomatoes, and corn.
ingredient_lines: 1 (28 ounce) can whole peeled tomatoes, chopped
instruction_lines: Combine salt pork, chicken, and water in a large pot; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer until chicken is tender, about 45 minutes.
Remove meat from chicken, chop into bite-sized pieces, and return to pot; discard skin and bones.
Add tomatoes, potatoes, onions, corn, lima beans, Worcestershire sauce, salt, and pepper. Simmer, uncovered, stirring occasionally, about 1 hour.
